system.description: A collection of lumpy, irregular, foul-looking puffballs. These fungi are an unhealthy-looking purple-green colour and smell somewhat dank. Careful; they're prone to popping! Encumbrance: 1 per “dose.” The slackfungus bombs may be thrown out to Close range by hand, or out to Medium range with a sling or catapult. Although they are unwieldy, they also don’t have to strike the target directly to be effective (so no modifier to hit). Anyone struck by a slackfungus bomb must make a Daunting (4{Dc}) Resilience check or be Sluggish and suffer -2 to all checks until the end of the encounter.
